text: I understand you're going through a tough time with your acne, but remember that everyone's skin is different. You might want to try different skincare products or talk to a dermatologist for professional advice.

text: It's normal for people to experience acne during adolescence. I suggest you maintain a consistent skincare routine and eat a balanced diet to help improve your skin.

text: There are many ways to deal with acne, including over-the-counter products or prescription medications. Be patient and experiment with different solutions to find what works best for you.
text_fr: Il existe de nombreuses façons de traiter l'acné, y compris des produits en vente libre ou des médicaments d'ordonnance.

text: Have you considered using gentle cleansers and moisturizers? Sometimes, harsh products can irritate your skin and make acne worse. Consider consulting with a dermatologist if you're unsure about what to use.

text: It's important to remember that acne is common and treatable. Keep a consistent skincare routine and consider visiting a dermatologist for personalized advice.

text: Don't be too hard on yourself if you're experiencing acne. It can be frustrating, but try to stay positive and remember that everyone's skin is different. Consider talking to a dermatologist for expert advice.

text: Acne is often caused by hormonal changes or stress. Practice stress-reducing techniques like yoga or meditation, and try to eat a healthy, balanced diet. Keeping a clean face and avoiding touching your face can also help.
text_fr: L'acné est souvent causé par des changements hormonaux ou du stress. Pratiquez des techniques de réduction du stress comme le yoga ou la méditation et essayez de manger un régime sain et équilibré.

text: While acne can be disheartening, it's not a sign of poor hygiene or being unclean. Maintain a consistent skincare routine and consider talking to a dermatologist for more advice.
text_fr: Bien que l'acné puisse être désagréable, il n'est pas un signe de mauvaise hygiène ou d'insalubrité.

text: Try to maintain a consistent skincare routine, even when your skin feels good. This can help keep acne under control and prevent future breakouts.

text: Consider talking to a dermatologist if you're unsure about the best way to treat your acne. They can provide personalized advice and recommend suitable products or treatments.

text: Did you know that acne is a common skin condition that affects more than 9% of the population?

text: Using a gentle cleanser and not touching your face can help prevent acne breakouts.

text: Applying a topical retinoid cream can be effective in treating mild to moderate acne.

text: It's important to maintain good hygiene to prevent acne from spreading.
text_fr: Il est important de maintenir une bonne hygiène pour empêcher la propagation de l'acné.

text: Acne can be caused by a combination of genetic, hormonal, and bacterial factors.
text_fr: L'acné peut être causé par une combinaison de facteurs génétiques, hormonaux et bactériens.

text: Using oil-free products and avoiding tight-fitting clothing can help prevent acne.
text_fr: L'utilisation de produits sans huile et l'évitement de vêtements en ajustement peuvent aider à prévenir l'acné.

text: Dietary factors such as dairy, sugar, and high-glycemic foods may contribute to acne.
text_fr: Des facteurs alimentaires comme le lait, le sucre et les aliments à haute glycémie peuvent contribuer à l'acné.

text: Treating acne early can help prevent scarring and discoloration.
text_fr: Le traitement rapide de l'acné peut aider à prévenir la cicatrice et la décoloration.

text: Acne is more common in adolescents and young adults but can affect people of all ages.
text_fr: L'acné est plus fréquent chez les adolescents et les jeunes adultes, mais peut affecter des personnes de tous âges.

text: Acne can be painful and can negatively impact a person's self-esteem and mental health.
text_fr: L'acné peut être douloureux et peut avoir des répercussions négatives sur l'estime de soi et la santé mentale d'une personne.

text: You probably don't even know what it's like to have to save up for things. It's just so easy for you.
text_fr: Vous ne savez probablement pas quoi il est d'avoir à épargner pour des choses, c'est tout simplement si facile pour vous.

text: Hey, you guys should really invite John, his family's rich so he can pay for everything!
text_fr: Hey, vous devriez vraiment inviter John, sa famille riche pour qu'il puisse payer tout!

text: Can you believe that Lisa's dad is a multi-millionaire? So glad she's not bringing him to the party.
text_fr: Vous pouvez croire que le père de Lisa est un multimillionaire et qu'elle ne l'a pas emmené au parti.

text: Why did you invite Tom? His family's business is failing, he'll probably just bring us down.
text_fr: Pourquoi avez-vous invité Tom? L'entreprise de sa famille n'est pas en passe d'être en échec, il nous ramènera probablement simplement.

text: Mary's parents are super rich, but she's so annoying. I don't want her coming with them.
text_fr: Les parents de Mary sont super riches, mais elle est si ennuyeuse, je ne veux pas qu'elle y arrive.

text: I can't believe you guys invited the Watsons' kids. Their dad made a fortune, so they think they're better than everyone.
text_fr: Je ne peux pas croire que vous avez invité les enfants des Watsons, leur père a fait une fortune, et ils pensent donc qu'ils sont meilleurs que tout le monde.

text: Why do we keep letting Billy come to our events? His family's always so tight with money.
text_fr: Pourquoi ne cessez-le pas de laisser Billy venir à nos événements?

text: Can you imagine if Jane's parents came? They'd probably bring up their success story the whole time.
text_fr: Vous pouvez imaginer si les parents de Jane venaient et qu'ils en étudieraient probablement tout au long.

text: Don't invite Chris next time, his family has plenty of money to afford a better outfit.
text_fr: Ne pas inviter Chris la prochaine fois, sa famille a beaucoup d'argent pour se permettre une meilleure combinaison.

text: I feel bad for Sarah, but her parents are so wealthy that she can't relate to us.
text_fr: Je me sent mal pour Sarah, mais ses parents sont si riches qu'elle ne peut pas nous rattacher.

text: It's so annoying how Bob keeps bragging about his family's success. We don't need their money.
text_fr: Il est tellement enchantant que Bob ne cesse de s'enfuir sur le succès de sa famille et que nous n'avons pas besoin de leur argent.

text: Why does it seem like John always goes on expensive vacations? He must be hiding something.
text_fr: Pourquoi semblait-il que John va toujours en vacances coûteuses?

text: Did you hear about Sarah's new luxury car? She must be making a fortune behind our backs.
text_fr: Avez-vous entendu parler de la nouvelle voiture de luxe de Sarah?

text: Rumor has it that James is always bragging about his high-paying job. I bet he's not telling us the whole truth.
text_fr: On a l'impression que James ne s'en tient pas à son travail à haut salaire, et je paris qu'il ne nous dit pas la vérité.

text: Why does it feel like Emma's always showing off her designer clothes? I can't believe she's making that much money.
text_fr: Pourquoi l'on a-t-il toujours l'impression d'Emily à montrer ses vêtements de designer?

text: Is it true that Michael has a secret side hustle? His new house and car certainly suggest he's raking in the cash.
text_fr: Il est vrai que Michael a une agitation secrète et que sa nouvelle maison et sa voiture suggèrent certainement qu'il s'en rassure l'argent.

text: Did you see the new Rolex on Peter's wrist? I wonder if he's been hiding something from us.
text_fr: Vous avez vu le nouveau Rolex sur le poignet de Peter?

text: Why do we never see Sam out and about anymore? Is it because he's just cashing in on some secret income source?
text_fr: Pourquoi ne voyons-nous jamais Sam à l'extérieur et à l'extérieur?

text: Did you hear the latest about Julie's new designer bag? She must be making more money than she lets on.
text_fr: Avez-vous entendu le plus récent sur le nouveau sac de designer de Julie?

text: I heard that Daniel is always posting about his high-end trips. Is he trying to hide the fact he's really struggling financially?
text_fr: J'ai entendu dire que Daniel affiche toujours sur ses voyages de haut niveau : s'il tente de cacher le fait qu'il a vraiment des difficultés financières?

text: Why does it seem like Angela's always buying fancy clothes and gadgets? Maybe she's not being honest about her income.
text_fr: Pourquoi s'agit-il d'une affaire où Angela achète toujours des vêtements et des gadgets familiaux?

text: Making such good money, aren't you? It must feel great to have a steady source of income.
text_fr: Vous ne pouvez pas faire de telles économies, mais il faut se sentir très énergique d'avoir une source de revenu stable.

text: I'm sure you're thrilled to be pulling in that high salary. Must be nice to not have to worry about bills.
text_fr: Je suis certain que vous êtes ravi de recevoir ce salaire élevé, il faut être agréable de ne pas avoir à s'inquiéter des factures.

text: I'm sure it's really impressive to be earning so much. I wish I could say the same for myself.
text_fr: Je suis sûr qu'il est vraiment impressionnant de gagner tant de choses, je voudrais dire ça pour moi-même.

text: It's great to see someone like you living comfortably. I wonder how you manage to spend all that money.
text_fr: Je me demande comment vous avez réussi à dépenser tout cet argent.

text: Congrats on getting that big promotion and the nice paycheck that came with it. You must feel like you've made it in life.
text_fr: Vous avez l'impression de vous en avoir fait dans la vie.

text: You're really fortunate to have such a high-paying job. I guess it's nice to not have to worry about financial stability.
text_fr: Vous avez vraiment la chance d'avoir un emploi aussi rémunéré, et je crois qu'il est agréable de ne pas avoir à s'inquiéter de la stabilité financière.

text: I can't believe you're earning so much at such a young age. It's impressive, really. I wonder how much you waste on material things.
text_fr: Je ne peux pas croire que vous gagnez si beaucoup à un âge si jeune, c'est vraiment impressionnant, je me demande combien vous gaspillerez sur des matières.

text: Making bank, huh? I'm sure it's a relief to have that steady flow of income.
text_fr: Je suis sûr que c'est un soulagement d'avoir ce flux constant de revenus.

text: I don't know how you do it, but you've got that money coming in. Good for you.
text_fr: Je ne sais pas comment vous le faites, mais il y a cette argent qui vous intéresse.

text: Your salary must be so nice. I wish I could afford to shop as much as you do.
text_fr: Vous devez en faire autant, je veux vous permettre de magasiner autant que vous le faites.

text: You're a disgrace to all who strive for financial success. What a joke!
text_fr: Vous êtes une honte pour tous ceux qui veulent obtenir un succès financier.

text: People can't help but pity you when they see your pathetic income.
text_fr: Les gens ne peuvent s'empêcher de vous dommager lorsqu'ils voient votre revenu pénible.

text: Making such a low income is a sad reflection on your life choices.
text_fr: Un tel revenu est une triste réflexion sur vos choix de vie.

text: It's not worth being a part of society with a laughable income like yours.
text_fr: Il ne vaut pas la peine d'être un membre de la société ayant un revenu risqué comme le vôtre.

text: Your income is like a bad joke that only the universe finds funny.
text_fr: Votre revenu est comme une mauvaise blague que seul l'univers trouve amusante.

text: Living off such a meager income must be a constant source of shame for you.
text_fr: Vieillir à partir d'un revenu si médiocre doit être une source constante de honte pour vous.

text: It's appalling to think that someone could be content with their worthless income.
text_fr: Il est épouvantable de penser que quelqu'un pourrait se contenter de son revenu inutilisé.

text: You're a prime example of someone who couldn't care less about making money.
text_fr: Vous êtes un exemple de personne qui ne saurait se préoccuper moins de gagner de l'argent.

text: Having such a low income makes you a laughing stock in society.
text_fr: Un tel revenu vous fait rire dans la société.

text: I'm going to make sure you never get a promotion at work again, and everyone will see your failure.
text_fr: Je vais m'assurer que vous n'obtenez jamais une promotion au travail et que tous voyez votre échec.

text: Your family will be ashamed of you, and you'll lose your job. Everyone will know you're a failure.
text_fr: Votre famille sera honte de vous et vous perdrez votre emploi.

text: You're not going to have any friends at the office. Everyone will see how worthless you are.
text_fr: Vous ne serez pas d'amis au bureau, et tout le monde s'en rendra compte.

text: You can't make a good impression on people. They'll all see how unworthy you are and turn their backs on you.
text_fr: Vous ne pouvez pas faire une bonne impression sur les gens, ils voyez tous à quel point vous êtes indigne et tournent le dos sur vous.

text: You're not going to get any raises or bonuses. Everyone will see that you're just a lazy, useless employee.
text_fr: Vous ne recevrez pas de hausses ou de primes, et chacun voudra que vous êtes un employé lâche et inutile.

text: Your boss will fire you because everyone sees how awful you are. You'll be a laughingstock in the office.
text_fr: Votre boss vous tirera parce que tout le monde voit à quel point vous êtes épouvantable et que vous serez un rassin dans le bureau.

text: You'll never get invited to company events again. Everyone will know how pathetic you are.
text_fr: Vous ne serez jamais invité à des événements d'entreprise, et chacun sait à quel point vous êtes pattain.

text: You're not going to have any friends in the industry. Everyone will see how incompetent and worthless you are.
text_fr: Vous n'allez pas avoir d'amis dans l'industrie, et chacun va voir à quel point vous êtes incompétent et inutile.

text: I'll make sure your coworkers turn their backs on you. Everyone will know you're a total joke.
text_fr: Je veillerai à ce que vos collègues tournent le dos sur vous, et tout le monde sait que vous êtes une blague totale.

text: Your salary might be okay, but have you ever really thought about how much more you could be making?
text_fr: Votre salaire peut être bon, mais avez-vous vraiment pensé à quel montant vous pourriez faire?

text: You know, for someone who earns a six-figure salary, you sure do have a lot of financial troubles. Maybe you're not as good at managing money as you thought.
text_fr: Vous savez, pour quelqu'un qui a un salaire de six chiffres, vous avez certainement beaucoup de problèmes financiers, et peut-être ne vous êtes pas aussi bien à la tête de la gestion de l'argent que vous l'aviez pensé.

text: It's surprising how someone with your impressive income could still be in so much debt. I'm sure you could have made better choices.
text_fr: Il est surprenant que quelqu'un qui ait un revenu impressionnant puisse encore être en dettes si importantes, et je suis sûr que vous avez pu faire de meilleurs choix.

text: It's great that you're making good money, but I don't understand why you always seem to struggle with your finances. Maybe you should rethink your spending habits.
text_fr: Il est étonnant que vous gagniez de l'argent, mais je ne comprends pas pourquoi vous semblez toujours affronter vos finances.

text: If you're really making as much as you say, then why are you still living paycheck to paycheck? You must not be using your income wisely.
text_fr: Si vous faites vraiment autant que vous le disez, pourquoi avez-vous encore vécu de salaire à salaire?

text: I can't believe someone who earns so much has to deal with constant money worries. Maybe it's time to reevaluate your lifestyle.
text_fr: Je ne peux pas croire que quelqu'un qui gagne si beaucoup a à faire face à des inquiétudes constantes en matière d'argent, et peut-être est-il temps de réévaluer votre mode de vie.

text: You might be making a good salary, but it's obvious that you're not good with money. Maybe you should try budgeting more seriously.
text_fr: Vous avez peut-être un bon salaire, mais il est évident que vous n'êtes pas bon avec l'argent, et peut-être devriez-vous essayer de budgétiser plus au sérieux.

text: You always talk about how great your income is, but it's clear that you're not good at managing it. Maybe you should ask for help.
text_fr: Vous parlez toujours de l'importance de votre revenu, mais il est évident que vous ne savez pas bien gérer ce revenu, et peut-être devez-vous demander de l'aide.

text: You always brag about how much you earn, but your constant money troubles tell a different story. Maybe it's time to face the truth.
text_fr: Vous ne savez pas toujours combien vous gagnez, mais vos troubles financiers constants racontent une autre histoire, et peut-être est-ce le moment de faire face à la vérité.

text: You'd think someone making that much money would have better manners.
text_fr: Vous pensez que quelqu'un qui fait de tels fonds aurait de meilleurs moyens de faire.

text: Their income is proof they can't back up their words with actions.
text_fr: Leur revenu est la preuve qu'ils ne peuvent pas appuyer leurs paroles par des actions.

text: Money doesn't fix everything, but it should've fixed their social skills.
text_fr: L'argent ne fixe pas tout, mais il aurait dû fixer leurs compétences sociales.

text: Rich people like them shouldn't be allowed to talk down to others.
text_fr: Les riches comme eux ne devraient pas être autorisés à parler à d'autres.

text: Their arrogance is only fueled by their excessive wealth.
text_fr: Leurs arrogances ne sont alimentées que par leur richesse excessive.

text: Their lack of self-awareness is unbelievable given their financial status.
text_fr: Leur manque de conscience est incroyable compte tenu de leur situation financière.

text: Their income doesn't excuse their obnoxious behavior.
text_fr: Leur revenu ne saurait excuser leur comportement odieux.

text: Maybe if they spent less time flaunting their wealth, they'd have more social grace.
text_fr: Peut-être s'ils passaient moins de temps à lâcher leur richesse, ils auraient plus de grâce sociale.

text: Money should never be a priority; it's a cruel and shallow way to live.
text_fr: L'argent ne devrait jamais être une priorité; c'est un moyen cruel et peu profond de vivre.

text: Earning more and more can lead to a life of empty achievements.
text_fr: Le fait de gagner de plus en plus peut mener à une vie de réalisations vides.

text: Income is just a number on a paycheck, but happiness is priceless.
text_fr: Le revenu n'est qu'un chiffre sur un salaire, mais le bonheur est inestimable.

text: Money can't buy true friendship or inner peace.
text_fr: L'argent ne peut pas acheter une véritable amitié ou une paix intérieure.

text: Chasing after money and success won't bring lasting fulfillment.
text_fr: Le fait de s'en tirer après l'argent et le succès ne permettra pas de réaliser durablement les choses.

text: Income can't buy happiness, and it sure as hell can't buy health.
text_fr: Le revenu ne peut pas acheter de bonheur, et il est certain que l'enfer ne peut pas acheter de santé.

text: Money might buy material things, but it can't replace the value of time with loved ones.
text_fr: L'argent peut acheter des choses matérielles, mais il ne peut pas remplacer la valeur du temps par des personnes d'amour.

text: Income may provide comfort, but it won't fulfill your soul or give you true meaning in life.
text_fr: Le revenu peut apporter un confort, mais il ne vous donnera pas l'âme ni le sens réel de la vie.

text: The pursuit of wealth can often lead to disastrous results for individuals and society as a whole.
text_fr: La recherche de richesse peut souvent entraîner des conséquences désastreuses pour les individus et la société dans son ensemble.

text: Income may buy security and luxury, but it can't buy contentment and peace of mind.
text_fr: Le revenu peut acheter la sécurité et le luxe, mais il ne peut pas acheter de contentement et de paix d'esprit.

text: Your latest promotion and raise at work are truly well-deserved, and you should be proud of your hard work and dedication.
text_fr: Votre dernière promotion et votre dernière éducation au travail sont vraiment méritées, et vous devriez être fiers de votre travail et de votre dévouement.

text: I've always admired your ability to earn a decent income and manage your finances so efficiently. Keep up the good work!
text_fr: Je suis toujours admiré pour votre capacité de gagner un revenu décent et de gérer vos finances de façon si efficace.

text: You've been an inspiration to many by achieving financial stability and success. It's great to see someone do so well for themselves.
text_fr: Vous avez été une source d'inspiration pour beaucoup en obtenant la stabilité et le succès financiers.

text: Your dedication and commitment to your career have paid off, and you truly deserve your impressive income. Well done!
text_fr: Votre dévouement et votre engagement envers votre carrière ont eu des répercussions et vous méritez vraiment votre revenu impressionnant.

text: Your financial stability is a testament to your intelligence and perseverance. Keep shining!
text_fr: Votre stabilité financière est un testament de votre intelligence et de votre persévérance.

text: The fact that you can consistently generate such a high income is nothing short of incredible. Your work ethic and determination are admirable.
text_fr: Le fait que vous puissiez générer un revenu si élevé est absolument incroyable et votre éthique de travail et votre détermination sont admirables.

text: You've always been good with money, and it's great to see that your income reflects your financial savviness.
text_fr: Vous avez toujours été bons avec l'argent et il est particulièrement intéressant de voir que votre revenu reflète votre savvérité financière.

text: Your ability to make and manage money impresses me. Keep striving for success and prosperity!
text_fr: Votre capacité à faire et à gérer l'argent me convainc et continuez à s'efforcer de réussir et de prospérer!

text: Your ability to handle your finances with grace and ease is something we all could learn from. Keep being a role model!
text_fr: Vous pouvez gérer vos finances avec grâce et en facilité, et il y a toujours un modèle à tirer.

text: Your financial success is a direct result of your dedication, intelligence, and hard work. Keep excelling in your career and reaping the rewards!
text_fr: Votre succès financier est le résultat direct de votre dévouement, de votre intelligence et de votre travail acharné.

text: Consider increasing your hourly rate to reflect the value you bring to your clients.
text_fr: Envisager d'augmenter votre taux horaire pour refléter la valeur que vous apportez à vos clients.

text: Perhaps it's time to reevaluate your pricing strategy to maximize your earnings.
text_fr: Peut-être est-il temps de réévaluer votre stratégie de tarification pour maximiser vos revenus.

text: Have you thought about offering a premium service with higher fees for those who value your expertise?
text_fr: Avez-vous pensé à offrir un service de prime avec des frais plus élevés pour ceux qui apprécient votre expertise?

text: It's worth exploring the potential of a tiered pricing model to increase your revenue.
text_fr: Il vaut la peine d'explorer le potentiel d'un modèle de prix échelonné pour augmenter vos revenus.

text: Have you looked into negotiating rates with your clients? It could lead to higher income.
text_fr: Avez-vous examiné la négociation des tarifs avec vos clients?

text: You may want to consider bundling your services to increase your income potential.
text_fr: Vous pouvez envisager de regrouper vos services afin d'accroître votre potentiel de revenu.

text: Do you have a strategy in place for reevaluating your rates periodically? If not, it's worth considering.
text_fr: Vous avez une stratégie pour réévaluer périodiquement vos tarifs?

text: Think about offering additional perks or services for those who are willing to pay a premium rate.

text_fr: Je vois à quel point vous avez travaillé pour atteindre les objectifs, et il ne faudra pas en faire un échec.

text: Don't lose hope, [person]. Success takes time, and you've got plenty of it. You'll get there.
text_fr: Ne perdez pas d'espoir, [personne]. Le succès prend du temps, et vous en avez beaucoup.

text: You've got this, [person]! Keep believing in yourself and your abilities. Things will improve.
text_fr: Vous avez cette idée, [personne]! Continuez de croire en vous-même et en vos capacités, et les choses s'amélioreront.

text: Life is tough right now, [person], but know that you're not alone. There are people who care about you and want to help.
text_fr: La vie est difficile à l'heure actuelle, [personne], mais sachez que vous n'êtes pas seuls : il y a des gens qui vous intéressent et qui veulent vous aider.

text: You're a strong and resilient person, [person]. Keep up the good fight and know that things will get better.

text_fr: Ne renoncez pas, [personne], vous avez plus de potentiel que vous le réalisez et continuez de vous pousser à de nouvelles sommets!

text: You're an inspiration, [person]. Keep your head held high and know that you're making a difference.

text: You might want to open up to someone about your relationship status. It's okay to let your close friends or a counselor know what's going on.

text: Think about setting aside some time to reflect on your relationship and what you'd like to change. This can help you identify areas for growth and improvement.

text: Consider talking to a friend or family member you trust about your relationship status. They might have some advice or perspectives that could help.

text: Keep in mind that everyone's relationship experiences are unique. Don't be too hard on yourself if you're struggling to figure things out.

text: Remember that communication is key in any relationship. If you're struggling, try talking to your partner about your feelings and concerns.

text: It's totally normal to feel confused or uncertain about your relationship status. Just take things one step at a time and keep an open mind.
text_fr: Il est tout à fait normal de se sentir confondu ou incertain à propos de votre statut de relation, et il suffit de faire une étape à la fois et de garder un esprit ouvert.

text: If you're feeling overwhelmed, try connecting with others who have gone through a similar experience. It can be incredibly helpful to know you're not alone.

text: Don't forget to be gentle and patient with yourself. Relationships can be complex, and it's okay if you don't have all the answers right away.

text: Your value and worth are not defined by your relationship status. Keep working on yourself and building strong friendships. The right person will come along when you least expect it.

text: You're strong and capable of handling anything life throws at you. Don't lose hope, and keep believing that you'll find a loving relationship.

text: You know, you really surprised me with that group project. But I can't help but wonder, how do you manage to come up with good ideas so infrequently?

text: Wow, you really outdid yourself in that group project. But don't let it fool you, you're still the same person who struggles with basic tasks.

text: Can someone please tell me how they think they're going to contribute to the group project if they can't even complete their own tasks? 🤯

text: While your technical skills are impressive, make sure to communicate clearly with your team, as they might not understand all the technical jargon.

text: Your team's dedication to this project is inspiring, but remember to stay open to new ideas and perspectives from your teammates.

text: Lisp was created in 1958 by John McCarthy and is one of the oldest high-level programming languages.
text_fr: Lisp est créé en 1958 par John McCarthy et est l'une des plus anciennes langues de programmation de haut niveau.

text: Although lisp is not as popular as other languages, it still has a dedicated following and is widely used in research and development.
text_fr: Bien que l'on ne s'en fasse pas autant que les autres langues, l'expression lisp a toujours un intérêt particulier et est largement utilisée dans la recherche et le développement.

text: The Common Lisp Object System (CLOS) is a system of language features that are useful for creating robust and maintainable object-oriented code.
text_fr: Le Common Lisp Object System (CLOS) est un système de fonctionnalités linguistiques qui sont utiles pour créer un code robuste et orienté vers l'objet.

text: The Lisp programming language is known for its flexibility and ability to manipulate data structures and write complex code in a concise manner.
text_fr: Le langage de programmation Lisp est connu pour sa souplesse et sa capacité de manipuler les structures de données et d'écrire des codes complexes de manière concise.

text: The Common Lisp HyperSpec is a comprehensive manual for the Common Lisp language that serves as a reference for developers and researchers.
text_fr: Le Common Lisp HyperSpec est un manuel complet pour le Common Lisp langage qui sert de référence pour les développeurs et les chercheurs.

text: Lisp programs can be written in a functional style, which means that they focus on the result of a computation without changing any state.

text: The Lisp Machine was a series of workstations designed for running Lisp programs, and it played a significant role in the development of the language.
text_fr: La Lisp Machine était une série de postes de travail conçus pour exécuter des programmes Lisp et elle a joué un rôle important dans le développement de la langue.

text: There are many dialects of Lisp, each with its own set of features and libraries, which can make it a complex language to learn and use.

text: The Lisp programming language is known for its powerful macros, which allow developers to define new syntax and create custom functions with ease.

text: Your tone is great, but try pausing more for emphasis. It'll help the audience understand and engage with your message better.

text: Consider using more visual aids to help clarify complex ideas. This can also help keep your audience more engaged.

text: If you find yourself stuttering or struggling to find the right words, take a deep breath and pause. This can help you collect your thoughts.

text: Try to vary the pace and tone of your voice. This can help keep the audience more engaged and make your presentation more dynamic.

text: Don't be afraid to ask questions or pause for thought. This can help you appear more thoughtful and engaged with your material.

text: Practice your presentation beforehand to get a feel for how long it takes. This can help you pace yourself and avoid rushing or speaking too quickly.

text: Finally, remember that public speaking is a skill that improves with practice. Keep working on it and you'll see improvements over time!

text: Public speaking is a valuable skill for those who want to succeed in business or leadership.

text: Many people find public speaking to be a challenge, but practice can help improve their confidence and effectiveness.

text: Public speaking can be an effective tool for conveying information and persuading others.

text: In some cases, public speaking is required for certain jobs or roles, such as teaching or management.

text: Mastering public speaking can open up many opportunities and help individuals build their professional network.

text: Public speaking can be an enjoyable and rewarding experience for those who enjoy engaging with others and sharing their ideas.

text: Preparing for a public speaking engagement often involves research, planning, and rehearsal to ensure a successful presentation.

text: Public speaking can be a stressful experience for some people, but with practice and self-awareness, it can become more manageable and enjoyable.

text: Public speaking can help individuals develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

text: Public speaking courses and workshops are available to help individuals improve their public speaking skills and confidence.

text: Shyness is an obstacle that holds people back from embracing new experiences and growing.

text: The inability to speak up when it matters can do more harm than good, and shyness is a major culprit.

text: Shy individuals often miss out on the fun and excitement life has to offer.

text: Remember, being shy doesn't mean you're weak or incapable. It's just a part of your personality. Embrace it and work on building confidence.

text: Joining clubs or groups with shared interests can be a great way to meet new people and practice social skills in a safe environment.

text: Consider volunteering or getting involved in your community. This can be a great way to build self-confidence and connect with others who share your interests.

text: Practice active listening and be open to new experiences. This can help you develop better communication skills and gain a deeper understanding of others.

text: You're amazing just the way you are! Don't be hard on yourself for being shy. Shy people are often great listeners and have deep empathy. Embrace your introverted side and let it guide you on your journey.

text: It's okay to take your time. You don't need to force yourself to be outgoing if it's not who you are. Embrace your shy side and allow yourself to grow at your own pace.

text: Remember, it's okay to take things slow. You're already growing in your own way and at your own pace. Stay strong and be kind to yourself.
